description: This header defines a thread-safe, bounded object pool implementation with various strategies, including fixed object pools, polymorphic object pools, and reference-counted object pools. It includes metrics collection, segment management, and object reclamation logic.

classes.name: bounded_object_pool_metrics_collector
classes.description: Helper class to collect pool metrics, with specialization for enabled/disabled metrics.

classes.name: bounded_object_pool_impl
classes.description: Implements the core logic of a thread-safe, segmented object pool with bitmap tracking and optional metrics.

classes.name: bounded_object_pool
classes.description: Main class providing a thread-safe object pool with fixed capacity, supporting object retrieval and metrics.

classes.name: bounded_unique_object_pool
classes.description: Object pool storing objects as unique_ptr, supporting polymorphic object storage.

classes.name: bounded_rc_object_pool
classes.description: Reference-counted object pool allowing shared ownership of objects with reference counting.

classes.name: segment
classes.description: Segment structure within pools, managing object array and bitmap.

classes.name: obj_control_block
classes.description: Control block for reference-counted objects, managing intrusive reference counting.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a free object from the pool, returning a RAII pointer.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of objects the pool can hold.

methods.name: size_approx
methods.description: Estimates the current number of allocated objects.

methods.name: are_metrics_active
methods.description: Checks if metrics collection is active.

methods.name: nof_alloc_reattempts
methods.description: Returns the number of allocation reattempts.

methods.name: nof_scanned_segments
methods.description: Returns the number of scanned segments during allocation.
